name: Synapse (Matrix)
description: The reference Matrix homeserver. Chat with people on any other Matrix server, bridge to other platforms, keep history on your own hardware. First admin user registers via /register.
compose:
services:
  synapse:
    image: matrixdotorg/synapse:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8008"
    environment:
      SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME: "${{cfg.server_name}}"
      SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS: "no"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
